content: खजः [खज्-अच्] .²1 A churning stick; पयस्यन्तर्हितं सर्पिर्यद्वन्निर्मथ्यते खजैः <ls>Mb. 12. 214. 21</ls>. .²2 Agitating, churning. .²3 A ladle or spoon. .{@-जा@} .²1 A churning stick, ladle; खजां च दर्वी च करेण धारयन् <ls>Mb. 4. 8. 1</ls>. .²2 The hand with the fingers extended. .²3 Churning, agitating, stirring. .²4 Killing, destroying. .²5 A battle.
